scripts.setup:env: npm run setup:env -w apps/api && npm run setup:env -w apps/client-portal && npm run setup:env -w apps/admin-panel
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/client-portal && npm install --prefix apps/admin-panel
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/client-portal" "npm run dev --prefix apps/admin-panel -- -- -p 3001"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix apps/client-portal && npm run build --prefix apps/admin-panel
